[Section] WikiQA
[source_id=45] The WikiQA corpus BIBREF15 is a publicly available dataset for open-domain question answering. This dataset contains 3,047 questions from Bing query logs, each associated with some candidate answer sentences from Wikipedia. We conducted experiments on WikiQA dataset using CNN, BiLSTM, and Attention based models. The results are shown in Table TABREF41 . The models built in NeuronBlocks achieved competitive or even better results with simple model configurations.
